DIAGNOSIS READY: Vascular Ring (likely Double Aortic Arch) with Esophageal Compression.

I have reviewed the imaging and swallow study results; the classic relief with neck extension and post-prandial vomiting confirm the diagnosis. This is a congenital anomaly requiring surgical division of the vascular ring. Please consult pediatric cardiothoracic surgery immediately for operative planning.
